name: Mimikko Yomekko
original_name: ミミっこ　ヨメっこ
source:
He woke up and the puppies he had picked up off the street turned into dog-eared girls!? Common sense doesn't apply to girls who used to be puppies!
This is the strange but sweet story of two cute loving puppy girls with dog ears who are all over you as they do whatever they like with you, just lapping you up. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE040485.html]DLsite English[/url]]
